desc:
FLYING ROADSTER
You saw the demo. Now drive it.

The new Roadster drove up a ramp, went upside down, launched, flipped and landed on its wheels. Production is years away. You don't have to wait.

Suction fans glue you to any surface. Cold-gas thrusters lift and boost you. Go up walls, across ceilings, off rooftops and onto a moving train.

- THE SPIRE: a 7-lap race track up a 1,000 ft tower
- THE LOOP: a tube tunnel under the city, ride the ceiling
- THE CUBE: 5 floors of Trackmania-style stages
- TURBO BALL: car football in an arena you can drive on the ceiling of
- The Sphere, the Gateway Arch, a mega ramp, a kart track and a cargo plane you can fly into

120 achievements: medal times, 25 hidden rings, 15 Golden Bolts, trick combos and secrets.

PC, controller and mobile.

No waitlist. No deposit. No 2028.
